# Frames barred from every corpus by review.
#
# One frame per line: <id> <reason>. A reason is required - without one, nobody later
# can tell whether the frame was broken or merely disliked, so nobody dares restore it.
#
# The automatic screen in src/screen.ts rejects burned-in overlays. This file is for
# defects a person has to judge. Orientation is the main one: OSV-5M ships frames rotated
# with the rotation baked into the pixels, and the pixel heuristics tried for it reached
# only about 68% precision, which is too low to act on automatically.
#
# This file outranks benchmark/samples/reviewed.txt. A frame approved and then dropped
# is named in both, and the later, stronger verdict is the rejection.
#
# There is no refill. The pool is the reviewed list, so an id here shrinks both corpora
# by one frame between them instead of promoting the next candidate by rank.
#
# After editing, regenerate both corpora and the image folder:
#   node src/sample.ts --freeze
#   npm run collect
